name: Amityville Music Hall
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: amh.live, amityvillechamberofcommerce.org, crescat.io.
reviewNotes:
Added for its own event calendar in src/content/sources (PR #8). The dance floor has not been researched yet.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Address confirmed on the venue's own site and Google Maps; Amityville is in Suffolk County (Town of Babylon). The site has no contact page, phone or email; the phone is the one on Google Maps. Older directories list (631) 397-0578 and amh198@gmail.com, and the Chamber of Commerce lists theamityvillemusichall@gmail.com with an owner's name and a cell number; since none of these appear on the venue's own site, email is left blank (owner may choose one). No hours are published (shows run on event nights only). This is a concert club for punk/emo/hardcore/indie shows rather than a social-dance venue; the site says nothing about a dance floor. The site shows only event flyers and logos, no venue photos, so no photos were recorded. Twitter link from the site converted to x.com.
description: A small concert club on Broadway in downtown Amityville, a short walk from the LIRR station. It books local and touring bands, mostly punk, emo, hardcore and indie rock, and most shows are open to ages 16 and up.

evidence.note: Venue's own site footer gives 198 Broadway, Amityville, NY 11701, links Facebook, Instagram and X (amh.live198 / amh_live198) and lists ticketed shows through October 2026.
Google Maps lists Amityville Music Hall (event venue) at 198 Broadway, Amityville, NY 11701, phone (631) 572-8929, website amh.live. No hours shown.
Amityville Chamber of Commerce member listing confirms the venue at 198 Broadway with website amh.live.
Venue directory describes it as a live music club a few minutes' walk from the Amityville LIRR station.
